subject: Access artifacts & minimal samples for SIG/CAIQ intake — SCIM / SAML / RBAC
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@prospectco.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: GRC Intake <grc-intake@prospectco.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: minimal access artifacts for SIG/CAIQ intake

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for taking this — our SOC/SIG intake folks asked for a compact set of artifacts to validate provisioning and SSO for a quick CAIQ pass. Can you provide the following by Oct 20 if possible?

- A small set (5–10) of SAML assertion samples showing typical attributes for user, admin, and service accounts
- A SCIM delta (1 week window) showing create/update/delete events for a tenant that reflects deprovisioning
- A current RBAC role matrix export and a brief least-privilege justification for any roles with broad scopes
- Any logs or notes showing automated provisioning flow and failure modes (if available)

If some items are sensitive (real emails/usernames), we can accept redacted samples with mapping notes. Also let us know if you need a signed NDA or additional context.

Appreciate it — Samir
Samir Patel
Senior GRC Analyst, ProspectCo

From: tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@prospectco.com>
Cc: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: minimal access artifacts for SIG/CAIQ intake

Samir — thanks for the clear ask.

Quick plan:
- We will produce a redacted SAML assertion sample set (3 account types) and a one-week SCIM delta from our staging tenant.
- Jonas will pull the RBAC matrix and include role descriptions + one-line justification for each elevated role.
- Vivek will include notes on typical provisioning failure modes and guidance on interpreting the SCIM delta.

Im targeting an initial bundle by Tue Oct 14 EOD PT (two-day turnaround) and a final, fully annotated packet by Mon Oct 20. If you need a signed NDA, please route it to legal@redwood.com and Ill expedite.

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Manager, Compliance & Security Programs
Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0198

Samir / Tessa — attaching the initial artifacts for your review. Notes below. Attachments: scim-delta-20251001.csv (redacted), saml-assertion-sample.txt, rbac-roles-and-justification.xlsx.

Quick notes:
- SCIM delta is from our staging tenant; email addresses are tokenized as user+{n}@example.com. It includes a window with 2 deprovision events. Column headers include timestamp, action, externalId, userName, and changedAttributes.
- SAML samples include 3 assertions: regular user, admin, and svc-integration account. Weve included the raw XML with attribute names and a short mapping doc in the text file.
- RBAC matrix has current roles, IDs, permissions, and a one-line justification column for each role that has write or admin scope.

Let us know if you want samples in a different format (JSON lines for SCIM, zipped asserts, etc.)

Jonas Weber
Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Infra)
Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@prospectco.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IAM artifact bundle — RBAC justifications and interpretive notes

Samir — adding a short interpretive note on RBAC and least privilege:

- Roles that are labeled "platform-admin" are intentionally scoped to operational tasks (deploys, infra ops). Admins are separated by tenant; no cross-tenant admin role exists.
- We maintain a weekly owner-review workflow (owners column in the RBAC sheet) to prune unused elevated privileges. That process is automated via a ticket if no owner responds for 2 weeks.
- For ease of review, we included a pivot in the XLSX that groups permissions by resource type and flags roles with >50% write permissions.

Ive also attached artifact-workback-202510.pdf which maps each requested item to the source system, redaction notes, and the expected delivery timeline for the final packet on Oct 20.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Security & Controls Engineer
Redwood Inference
